verdict.rationale: The evidence shows the building blocks: SmartScan automatically extracts merchant, date, total and currency in realtime, existing corporate cards can be imported (BYOC), and the travel page loosely implies trips don't leave a pile of receipts. No item explicitly documents receipts being auto-matched to card transactions. Missing for 10: documented automatic receipt-to-card-transaction matching, e-receipts pulled from integrations, missing-receipt-only nudges, and independent corroboration.
